title: Local data
subtitle: Trip data is stored in this browser only. Export a copy before deleting data or changing devices.
storage.title: Storage facts
storage.local: This browser on this device only.
storage.limit: The browser or operating system can clear local storage, for example after storage pressure, privacy cleanup or clearing site data. There is no cloud backup.
storage.backup: Manual export only. Keep your own copy if the trips matter to you.
storage.corrupt: Unreadable records are skipped so the app can continue. A quarantined raw copy may remain in browser storage.
storage.model: No account, backend, cross-device sync or analytics.
export.title: Export
export.body: Download all trips as a documented JSON file (format dala-safe-trip-export, version 1).
export.privacy: Privacy warning: the file contains personal trip details, including notes, trusted-contact details and any route data stored with a trip. It is not encrypted. Store it securely.
export.empty: There are no trips to export yet.
import.title: Import
import.body: Restore trips from a Dala Safe JSON export.
import.merge: Existing trips are kept. A trip with the same id is replaced by the imported version; new trips are added first. If a file repeats an id, the last copy wins.
import.button: Choose a Dala Safe JSON file
import.done: Import complete. Trips in file: {count}; new: {added}; replaced: {replaced}.
import.noTrips: This export contains no trips. Nothing was changed.
import.invalid: This file is not a valid Dala Safe export. Nothing was changed.
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than {size} MB. Nothing was changed.
import.readError: The file could not be read. Nothing was changed.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Dala Safe has no account, backend, analytics or cross-device sync. Trip data is not sent to a server by the app. Location requested on the emergency screen is shown for that moment and is not stored automatically. Messages generated by the app are not sent automatically.
delete.title: Delete all data
delete.body: This permanently removes all trips and settings from this browser. It cannot be undone.
delete.reloadNote: After deletion, the language returns to the default (Kazakh) when the app is reloaded. Any browser-level backup or exported copy you made is not deleted.
delete.done: All local data was deleted from this browser.
delete.confirmBody: All trips, checklist progress, safety plans and settings will be removed from this browser. There is no cloud backup.
delete.exportFirstHint: If you need a copy, cancel and use “Export a copy first”.
